current.text: He is set to play almost only small forward in a crowded Portland backcourt, next to two other guards.
Portland has several high-usage ball handlers: Damian Lillard, Ja Morant, Scoot Henderson and Deni Avdija.
He is expected to come off the bench and to start only when Morant or Lillard is out.
His usage of 24 last season is expected to drop to a low-usage corner spacer role, like his role in Boston.
Shaedon Sharpe is injured, which frees some backup minutes in Portland.
Experts are low on him this season. He is solid, but his upside is limited by the crowd around him, even with Sharpe out.
Portland has a new head coach. Minutes and usage are expected to swing from game to game across the rotation.

durable.text: He can play well in a low-usage role. In Boston he played at a usage of 15 to 16.
His projected category profile has no weak category and no big strength. Assists and threes are slightly above the pool.

note: Both sites rank him around the cut line (Yahoo 139, ESPN 141) with a value of 0, and our league paid 3 USD for him last season. He is a 1 USD last pick at most. His 16.3 points and 6.1 assists last season came at a usage of 24, but projections drop him to about 12 points and 4.5 assists in a smaller role. He fits any build but helps no category much, so let him go to waivers and watch early whether he starts and what he does when Morant or Lillard miss games.
